=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:219-220 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The nested node_modules mount filter `[[ "${rel}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._@+/-]+$ ]] || continue` rejects nested project paths that contain spaces or other punctuation, such as `~`, `(` and `)`. `codex_isolated_workspace.py` `safe_name()`, `readonly_allowed()` and `handoff_nested_deps()` accept those paths, so their prepared `node_modules` is skipped silently and nothing is logged.
  WHY: Tests in that project cannot resolve packages in `/source` or `/baseline` and fail in both trees. `classify_baseline` marks them `inherited`, and `run_gate` reports `pass`, which hides a PR-caused regression. Severity disagrees: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, and the other five rated it MAJOR. The highest rating is used here.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:200-201 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` is accepted up to 360, and README documents the range as 1-360. The workflow step has `timeout-minutes: 60` (`.github/workflows/implement.yml:5365`), and the wrapper's wall clock is `timeout_minutes * 60 + 120` (`scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:238`).
  WHY: Above about 58 minutes, GitHub kills the step before `result.json` and the summary are written. Because the step is `continue-on-error: true`, the PR body silently loses the `## Pre-push test gate` section. The repair turn is also always skipped (`reason=step_budget`, because `run_wall` exceeds the 3300-second budget). All four reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:19 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES allows up to 360, but the workflow step timeout (implement.yml) is 60m.
  WHY: GitHub kills the job before the wrapper's timeout and result handling complete, leaving the pipeline without the required result or PR-body summary. This is the same root cause as the 200-201 entry, but it is kept separate because line 19 is not within 5 lines of 200-201. Rated MAJOR, while the other reviewers rated the 200-201 entry NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Write ${RUNTIME_DIR}/prepush_test_gate_summary.md, which states pass / fail / UNVERIFIED."
  expected_change_site: scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, summary construction (lines 156-183, the summary helper)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The summary helper (line 158, `status_of(result)`) copies the status from result.json unchanged. `prepush_affected_tests.py` returns `skipped` when no units are selected, and `gate.write_summary` prints "Status: **skipped**", which is not pass, fail or UNVERIFIED. No code maps `skipped` to one of the three specified outcomes. All three reviewers rated it NIT. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this gap as `skipped` is a documented outcome.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:nested node_modules loop, `[[ "${rel}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._@+/-]+$ ]] || continue` (in the `--nested-node-modules-root` block) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The filter is narrower than `codex_isolated_workspace.py` `find_nested_node_projects()` and `handoff_nested_deps()`, which accept any path passing `safe_name()` / `readonly_allowed()` (lines 183-202, 736-742, 822-826). That includes spaces, `~`, `(` and `)`. Such projects are skipped with `continue`, and nothing is logged.
  WHY: Tests cannot resolve packages in `/source` or `/baseline` and are classified `inherited`, so the gate reports `pass` or `unverified` and hides a real regression. A suggested fix is to reject only `,`, newlines and control characters, and to log `reason=nested_node_modules_unsafe_path`.
- Notes: the timeout bound was not re-reported (it predates the last run and the push is not blocked). The `skipped` TASK_GAP was rejected. The last-run changes were verified (automation-path narrowing, `CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_TIMEOUT_SECS`, dynamic scoping, symlink backup under `RUNTIME_DIR`, rollback-failure flag).
- HARDENING: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh, nested node_modules loop. Rejected paths are skipped without a log line. Fix: `gate_log "outcome=warning reason=nested_node_modules_unsafe_path"` before each `continue`.
- HARDENING: scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, implement_prepush_test_gate_repair, `[ "${ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS:-true}" != "true" ]`. This default disagrees with the `false` default in `implement_prepush_test_gate_narrow_allow_list`. Fix: `${ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS:-false}`.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:line 220, inside the `--nested-node-modules-root` loop (lines 213-233) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `[[ "${rel}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._@+/-]+$ ]] || continue` rejects paths with spaces or non-ASCII characters. The producer does not apply that restriction: `scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:183 safe_name()`, `readonly_allowed()` (line 192), `find_nested_node_projects()` (line 717) and `handoff_nested_deps()` (line 784, guard at line 822) install `node_modules` for paths such as `apps/my app/`.
  WHY: `/source` and `/baseline` lack node_modules (`scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:31`), so the tests fail in both trees. `classify_baseline()` (`workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:680-691`) marks them inherited, `run_gate()` (line 740-747) sets `status = "pass"`, no repair runs, and the PR-caused failure reaches PR CI.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:lines 200-201 (`gate_timeout` clamp); `.github/workflows/implement.yml:5365` (`timeout-minutes: 60`); `scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:238` (`wall=$(( timeout_minutes * 60 + 120 ))`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The timeout is accepted up to 360 minutes, and README documents "1-360", but the step's GitHub timeout is 60 minutes.
  WHY: Above about 58 minutes, GitHub kills the step before `result.json` is copied back and the summary is written. With `continue-on-error: true`, the PR body silently loses the `## Pre-push test gate` section. `run_wall` (`implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:667`) also pushes the remaining 3300-second budget below 300 (`reason=step_budget`), so the repair is always skipped.
- Notes: all eight deliverables of the linked issue were verified. The last-run diff closed the previously reported gaps.
- HARDENING: scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh line 496 (`[ "${ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS:-true}" != "true" ]`) vs line 467 (`--allow-workflow-edits "${ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS:-false}"`). The two defaults are opposite. Fix: use `${ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS:-false}` at line 496.
- HARDENING: scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh line 173 (`RUN python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages ruff==0.17.2`). The image shared by every phase hard-depends on an exact PyPI pin. Fix: add a fallback such as `ruff==0.17.2 || ruff`.
- HARDENING: scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh line 440-441. `auto` / `auto_denied` are never truncated, so a second repair turn would re-admit stale denied paths. Fix: add `: > "${auto}"` and `: > "${auto_denied}"`.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
